label: Early original-phase input from a fixed token set (m,k,p,b,...), peaking at step 2
predicate: (phase == 0) & (((t == 2) & isin(in_tok, [tok(c) for c in "mkpbqaotj3v"])) | ((t != 2) & (t >= 1) & (t <= 3) & isin(in_tok, [tok(c) for c in "mkpb"])))
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase at steps 1-3, and only when the current input is one of a preferred token set. About 95% of activation mass falls at t=1..3, with 62% at t=2. It never fires at t=0. At t=2 the set is broad: m, k, p, b, q, a, o, t, j, 3, v. At t=1 and t=3 it is mostly m/k/p/b. Magnitude is largest for m (30% of mass; top examples are m at t=2, or m m at t=1-2), then k, p and b. It is weaker at t=1 than at t=2, and rate drops quickly past t=3 (almost zero from t>=5 of the original phase). There is small residual mass at the <DEL> step (about 4%, more common for short L=3/4 sequences) and almost none in the copy phase (about 1%). Activation is higher on the first occurrence of a token. It is selective for the identity of the current input token and does not depend on first_tok or prev_tok. Misses are mostly weak activations on other tokens at t=2-3 and on <DEL> in short sequences. Dev F1 is 0.79 and mass recall 0.89.
